title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Patel
description:
Context: Customers in regulated industries require strict data residency guarantees and cryptographic key locality. Previous RBAC v2 policy enforcement allowed KMS region mismatches to pass as warnings; this left gaps where resources could be created with non-compliant keys when fallback logic applied. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time, expands audit logging for KMS operations, and hardens the policy migration path to avoid accidental global key usage. Changes are implemented in the RBAC v2 policy engine, the KMS integration layer, and the audit pipeline.

Scope: 1) Enforce policy-level KMS region pinning (deny when resource KMS region differs from allowed residency unless explicit override present and reviewed). 2) Add high-fidelity audit events for KMS key selection, key-residency checks, policy decisions, and policy override requests. 3) Migration tool and safe rollout: CLI migration that scans existing resources and produces remediation suggestions, a canary flag to enable enforcement only for selected orgs, and a fallback plan for on-call. 4) Tests: unit tests for policy engine predicates, e2e tests with mock KMS, integration tests for audit events and downstream log consumers.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-1543, SEC-78) linked - [x] Policy changes implemented with backward-compatible gate (feature flag) - [x] Migration scanner and remediation report - [x] Audit event schema v2 added and downstream consumer test - [x] Unit/e2e/integration tests - [x] Security review and threat model adjustments

Motivation and rationale: Enforcing region pinning at the RBAC layer prevents accidental cross-region key usage and centralizes decision-making in a single policy plane, which simplifies audits and compliance attestations. Audit changes provide traceability for every policy decision and key selection, improving incident investigations.

Summary of commits: 1) Add policy predicate kms_region_matches_allowed_residency + unit tests; 2) KMS client: attach residency metadata and region hints to key selection logic; 3) Audit: emit kms.key_selected, kms.policy_decision, kms.override_requested events with structured fields; 4) Migration scanner and remediation CLI; 5) Feature-flag gate + rollout orchestration; 6) Tests and docs.

Files changed (high level): - rbac/policy/engine/*.go (policy predicates, evaluation paths) - integrations/kms/client.go (region-aware key selection) - observability/audit/schema/v2.json and observability/audit/emitter.go - tools/migration/kms_residency_scanner.py and scripts for remediation - ci/test-integration/kms_e2e.yml - docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md

Review summary: Initial review by Evan Brooks requested stronger test coverage for cross-account key aliases and suggested a clearer audit schema for downstream SIEMs. Janelle Kim requested a migration/rollout plan to avoid global enforcement spikes; asked for feature-flag gating. Carlos Rivera flagged one potential perf regression in policy evaluation and asked for microbenchmarks. Author responses: addressed test gaps, added migration CLI and remediation runbook, optimized predicate short-circuit to avoid measurable overhead.

Review conversation (high level): Evan: "Please add test that simulates alias resolution across two regions and confirm denial when residency mismatch." Maya: "Added e2e test and documented expected failure modes." Janelle: "How do we roll this out without breaking customers?" Maya: "Added canary flag, automated remediation report, and org-level opt-in. Will coordinate with customer success for early adopters." Carlos: "Benchmarks?" Maya: "Added benchmark results to PR and optimized predicate to memoize residency lookups; <5% median latency impact in our microbench harness."

CI status: initial CI run showed a lint failure and a flaky e2e that was due to test timing; fixes pushed 2026-02-26; final CI status: pass.

Files changed count: 12, additions: ~860, deletions: ~124.

Deploy and rollout plan: Merge gated behind security approval and staged rollout: 1) enable audit-only mode globally for one week, 2) enable enforcement for 5% orgs for 48 hours, 3) expand to 25% then 100% after remediation window and successful alerts.

Monitoring/alerts: new audit-based alert if override rate > 0.5% or migration scanner finds >50 non-compliant resources in a single org.

Backout plan: feature-flag disable and automated remediation suggestions.

Migration notes: migration CLI will generate a CSV with offending resources and suggested remediation (rekeying or update residency tags).

Release notes: Enforced KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 with audit logging hardening and migration tooling; enabled behind feature flag for staged rollout.

Merge details: squash-merged into main after approvals from Evan Brooks and Janelle Kim and security review from Carlos Rivera.

Links: Linear ENG-1543, SEC-78; internal runbook link included in reviewers' thread.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 (feature-flagged); add audit event schema v2 for KMS decisions; migration scanner and remediation CLI; staged rollout plan; security hardening.
